description: Capability for every app window. `ws-*` matches the windows a workspace moves into (workspace_window.rs), which are the same app and need the same permissions -- a workspace window with no capability would come up dead. The opener plugin carries no path permission: `allow-open-path` was scoped to `/**` and `**` and `opener:default`'s `allow-reveal-item-in-dir` has no scope at all, so both now go through fileviewer.rs's `open_path_externally`/`reveal_path_externally`, which answer against the open workspace roots -- a scope that changes while the app runs and so cannot live in this file. What is left is the URL half: `allow-open-url` plus `allow-default-urls`, which is where the mailto/tel/http/https scheme scope comes from. The dialog plugin is narrowed to allow-open deliberately: a file picker is a real OS service, while alerts and confirms are drawn in-app by dialog.ts + AppDialog.svelte, so a reintroduced native message()/confirm() fails here rather than quietly looking foreign.
